entries.en: The road was icy, but we travelled just the same.
entries.zh: 路上结了冰，但我们还是出行了。

entries.en: Please keep a close watch on the rising water.
entries.zh: 请密切注意不断上涨的水位。

entries.en: Can you keep a secret until her birthday?
entries.zh: 在她生日到来之前，你能保守秘密吗？

entries.en: We must keep a tight rein on our spending.
entries.zh: 我们必须严格控制开支。

entries.en: Please keep a watchful eye on the sleeping baby.
entries.zh: 请密切留意睡着的婴儿。

entries.en: The cyclist struggled to keep abreast of the leading car.
entries.zh: 骑车人努力保持与领头的汽车并行。

entries.en: She takes odd jobs to keep body and soul together.
entries.zh: 她靠打零工勉强维持生计。

entries.en: I prefer to keep company with honest people.
entries.zh: 我更愿意与诚实的人结交。

entries.en: We must keep faith with those who trusted us.
entries.zh: 我们必须对信任我们的人信守承诺。

entries.en: She learned to keep house while still very young.
entries.zh: 她很小就学会了料理家务。

entries.en: He tries to keep in with the senior partners.
entries.zh: 他设法讨好那些资深合伙人。

entries.en: Your work is improving, so keep it up.
entries.zh: 你的工作在进步，继续保持吧。

entries.en: Do not keep on at me about my haircut.
entries.zh: 别再为我的发型反复唠叨我了。

entries.en: Our training must keep pace with changing technology.
entries.zh: 我们的培训必须跟上技术的变化。

entries.en: Can you keep score during the next game?
entries.zh: 下一局比赛时，你能记录得分吗？

entries.meaningZh: 不断向某人提供最新情况
entries.en: Please keep Maya posted about any changes.
entries.zh: 如果有什么变化，请及时告诉玛雅。

entries.term: keep the wolf from the door
entries.en: His small pension helps keep the wolf from the door.
entries.zh: 他微薄的养老金帮助他勉强糊口。

entries.en: The dancers struggled to keep time with the music.
entries.zh: 舞者们努力跟上音乐的节拍。

entries.en: Please keep to the agreed schedule this week.
entries.zh: 本周请遵守商定的时间安排。

entries.en: This chart helps us keep track of spending.
entries.zh: 这张图表帮助我们掌握开支情况。

entries.en: They borrowed money to keep up appearances.
entries.zh: 他们借钱来维持体面的外表。

entries.en: I could not keep up with the faster walkers.
entries.zh: 我跟不上走得更快的人。

entries.en: Please key in your reference number carefully.
entries.zh: 请仔细键入你的参考编号。

entries.en: Regular keyboarding practice improved her typing speed.
entries.zh: 经常练习键盘输入提高了她的打字速度。

entries.en: Young people sometimes kick against strict family rules.
entries.zh: 年轻人有时会反抗严格的家规。

entries.en: Our new drummer can really kick ass.
entries.zh: 我们的新鼓手真他妈厉害。

entries.en: Passengers may kick up a fuss about another delay.
entries.zh: 如果再次延误，乘客们可能会大闹抗议。

entries.term: kill two birds with one stone
entries.en: We can kill two birds with one stone by cycling there.
entries.zh: 我们骑车去那里，就可以一举两得。

entries.en: The gardener knelt beside the bed to examine the seedlings.
entries.zh: 园丁跪在花床旁检查幼苗。

entries.en: I knew the answer before she finished speaking.
entries.zh: 她还没说完，我就知道了答案。

entries.en: The loose pipes knock together when the wind blows.
entries.zh: 风吹时，那些松动的管子会相互碰撞。

entries.en: You should know better than to touch exposed wires.
entries.zh: 你应该懂得不能触碰裸露的电线。

entries.en: Ask Lena; she will know the ropes.
entries.zh: 问莉娜吧，她熟悉这里的门道。

entries.en: They ladle out soup to everyone in the queue.
entries.zh: 他们给排队的每个人舀汤。

entries.en: The dog had lain beside the fire all evening.
entries.zh: 那条狗整个晚上都躺在炉火旁。

entries.en: Do not lash out at people offering advice.
entries.zh: 不要痛斥那些提出建议的人。

entries.en: I always check the door locks last thing at night.
entries.zh: 我晚上睡觉前最后总会检查门锁。

entries.en: Children often latch onto new ideas surprisingly quickly.
entries.zh: 孩子们往往会以惊人的速度领会新想法。

entries.en: Please do not launch into another lengthy speech.
entries.zh: 请不要又开始长篇大论。

entries.en: Do not lay a finger on the wet paint.
entries.zh: 不要用手碰还没干的油漆。

entries.en: The investigation will lay bare the causes of the collapse.
entries.zh: 调查将揭露倒塌的原因。

entries.en: Both families lay claim to the same field.
entries.zh: 两个家庭都声称拥有同一块田地。

entries.en: Lay on the paint with broad, even strokes.
entries.zh: 用宽而均匀的笔触涂抹油漆。

entries.en: The army prepared to lay siege to the castle.
entries.zh: 军队准备围攻城堡。

entries.en: Please lead the way to the nearest exit.
entries.zh: 请带路前往最近的出口。

entries.en: These short exercises lead up to a longer project.
entries.zh: 这些简短的练习为一个较大的项目作准备。

entries.en: You can leaf through the catalogue while waiting.
entries.zh: 等待时，你可以翻阅目录。

entries.en: I lean towards the cheaper of the two designs.
entries.zh: 我倾向于两个设计中较便宜的那个。

entries.en: He leant against the wall and closed his eyes.
entries.zh: 他倚着墙，闭上了眼睛。

entries.en: The cat leapt onto the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 猫跳到了厨房桌上。

entries.en: She learnt to swim during the summer holidays.
entries.zh: 她在暑假期间学会了游泳。

entries.en: Left-click the icon to open the document.
entries.zh: 用鼠标左键单击这个图标，打开文档。

entries.en: We decided to let bygones be bygones and cooperate.
entries.zh: 我们决定既往不咎，展开合作。

entries.en: He let drop a hint about the surprise party.
entries.zh: 他无意中透露了一点有关惊喜派对的消息。

entries.en: She let fall the curtain across the doorway.
entries.zh: 她放下帘子，遮住了门口。

entries.en: The driver shouted, "Let her rip!" as we accelerated.
entries.zh: 我们加速时，司机喊道：“全速前进！”

entries.en: Only ticket holders were let into the hall.
entries.zh: 只有持票者才被允许进入大厅。

entries.en: Tonight we can dance and let it all hang out.
entries.zh: 今晚我们可以跳舞，尽情放松。

entries.en: I run after work to let off steam.
entries.zh: 我下班后跑步，以释放压力。

entries.en: The band began to let rip after the quiet introduction.
entries.zh: 安静的前奏结束后，乐队开始尽情演奏。

entries.en: Perhaps we should let sleeping dogs lie for now.
entries.zh: 也许我们眼下不该再翻旧账。

entries.en: She let slip the location of the hidden key.
entries.zh: 她无意中透露了藏钥匙的地方。

entries.en: Prices should level out after the initial shortage ends.
entries.zh: 最初的短缺结束后，价格应该会趋于平稳。

entries.en: Lie back and rest your head on the cushion.
entries.zh: 向后躺，把头靠在垫子上。

entries.en: He would not lift a finger to help us.
entries.zh: 他连一点忙都不肯帮。

entries.en: We may light on a solution during the discussion.
entries.zh: 我们也许会在讨论中偶然发现解决办法。

entries.en: Like it or not, the deadline cannot change.
entries.zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，截止日期都不能改。

entries.en: Please listen to reason before making this costly decision.
entries.zh: 在作出这个代价高昂的决定前，请听听理性的劝告。

entries.en: They live off the vegetables they grow themselves.
entries.zh: 他们靠自己种的蔬菜生活。

entries.en: She lived through two wars and several floods.
entries.zh: 她经历了两次战争和几场洪水。

entries.en: The crowd shouted, "Long live the king!"
entries.zh: 人群高呼：“国王万岁！”

entries.en: We must look ahead and plan for retirement.
entries.zh: 我们必须着眼未来，为退休作规划。

entries.en: Some neighbours look askance at our unusual garden.
entries.zh: 一些邻居对我们不同寻常的花园抱怀疑态度。

entries.en: I look forward to seeing you next month.
entries.zh: 我盼望下个月见到你。

entries.en: I will look in on my aunt tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我明天会顺便去看望姑妈。

entries.en: Look out for loose stones on the path.
entries.zh: 留神小路上松动的石头。

entries.en: Please look over the figures before we submit them.
entries.zh: 提交这些数字之前，请检查一遍。

entries.en: You are welcome to look round the workshop.
entries.zh: 欢迎你参观这间作坊。

entries.en: I need to look through the files again.
entries.zh: 我需要再查看一遍这些文件。

entries.en: Do not lose heart after one disappointing result.
entries.zh: 不要因为一次令人失望的结果就灰心。

entries.en: Small shops may lose out when the supermarket opens.
entries.zh: 超市开业后，小商店可能会受到损失。

entries.en: I do not want to lose touch with old friends.
entries.zh: 我不想与老朋友们失去联系。

entries.en: It is easy to lose track of changing regulations.
entries.zh: 不断变化的规定很容易让人跟不上。

entries.en: Some leaders lust for power rather than public service.
entries.zh: 一些领导人渴望权力，而不是为公众服务。

entries.en: The children always make a beeline for the swings.
entries.zh: 孩子们总是径直奔向秋千。

entries.en: The prisoner tried to make a break for it.
entries.zh: 那个囚犯试图逃跑。

entries.en: He sells old furniture to make a buck.
entries.zh: 他卖旧家具来赚钱。

entries.en: We should make a clean sweep of these outdated rules.
entries.zh: 我们应该彻底清除这些过时的规定。

entries.en: Do not make a fool of your younger brother.
entries.zh: 不要让你弟弟出丑。

entries.en: Please do not make a fuss about the delay.
entries.zh: 请不要为这次延误大惊小怪。

entries.en: The grandparents always make a fuss of the children.
entries.zh: 祖父母总是格外宠爱孩子们。

entries.en: Try to make a habit of checking your work.
entries.zh: 试着养成检查自己工作的习惯。

entries.en: An unclear introduction can make a hash of the presentation.
entries.zh: 含糊不清的开场可能会把整个演示搞砸。

entries.en: They hope to make a killing selling concert tickets.
entries.zh: 他们希望靠卖演唱会门票大赚一笔。

entries.en: Use a pencil to make a mark here.
entries.zh: 用铅笔在这里做一个记号。

entries.en: I should make a mental note of that address.
entries.zh: 我应该把那个地址记在心里。

entries.en: We should make a move before the traffic worsens.
entries.zh: 我们应该在交通变糟之前动身。

entries.en: I make a point of answering every letter.
entries.zh: 我特别注意回复每一封信。

entries.en: When the gate opens, we can make a run for it.
entries.zh: 大门打开时，我们就可以跑出去。

entries.en: The young designer hopes to make a splash this year.
entries.zh: 这位年轻设计师希望今年能引起轰动。

entries.en: Please do not make a thing of my mistake.
entries.zh: 请不要对我的错误小题大作。

entries.en: We should make allowances for her lack of experience.
entries.zh: 我们应该体谅她经验不足。

entries.en: I tried to make conversation during the long wait.
entries.zh: 长时间等待时，我试着找话聊。

entries.en: We will have to make do with one camera.
entries.zh: 我们只好将就用一台相机。

entries.en: Many families struggle to make ends meet.
entries.zh: 许多家庭勉强维持收支平衡。

entries.en: Do not make fun of anyone's accent.
entries.zh: 不要取笑任何人的口音。

entries.en: We must make haste before the storm arrives.
entries.zh: 我们必须在暴风雨到来之前赶紧行动。

entries.en: Please make it snappy; our train leaves soon.
entries.zh: 请快一点，我们的火车很快就要开了。

entries.en: You should not make light of her concerns.
entries.zh: 你不应该对她的担忧不当回事。

entries.en: The children make like pirates during their games.
entries.zh: 孩子们玩游戏时装成海盗。

entries.en: The butcher will make mincemeat of the remaining beef.
entries.zh: 屠夫会把剩下的牛肉剁碎。

entries.en: It is difficult to make money in the first year.
entries.zh: 第一年很难赚到钱。

entries.en: These contradictory figures make nonsense of the report.
entries.zh: 这些相互矛盾的数字让报告变得毫无意义。

entries.en: I do not know what to make of his silence.
entries.zh: 我不知道该如何理解他的沉默。

entries.en: The thieves tried to make off with the cash.
entries.zh: 小偷们试图带着现金逃走。

entries.en: Can you make sense of these confusing instructions?
entries.zh: 你能弄懂这些令人困惑的说明吗？

entries.en: This sharp blade will make short work of the branches.
entries.zh: 这把锋利的刀能很快处理掉这些树枝。

entries.en: Make sure that all the windows are closed.
entries.zh: 务必确保所有窗户都关上了。

entries.en: We must make the best of our limited space.
entries.zh: 我们必须充分利用有限的空间。

entries.en: Let us make the most of this sunny afternoon.
entries.zh: 我们充分利用这个阳光明媚的下午吧。

entries.en: We had better make tracks before it gets dark.
entries.zh: 我们最好在天黑之前赶紧离开。

entries.en: Extra staff can help make up for lost time.
entries.zh: 增加员工可以帮助弥补损失的时间。

entries.en: He tries to make up to anyone with influence.
entries.zh: 他试图讨好每一个有影响力的人。

entries.en: We should make use of the empty classrooms.
entries.zh: 我们应该利用那些空教室。

entries.en: It was difficult, mark you, but not impossible.
entries.zh: 注意，那很困难，但并非不可能。

entries.en: They wanted to marry off their eldest daughter.
entries.zh: 他们想让大女儿出嫁。

entries.en: This inexpensive model is designed for the mass market.
entries.zh: 这款价格低廉的型号是为大众市场设计的。

entries.en: The figures in these two reports do not match up.
entries.zh: 这两份报告中的数字对不上。

entries.en: The service did not match up to our expectations.
entries.zh: 服务没有达到我们的期望。

entries.meaningZh: 就事论事地，平静如实地
entries.en: She matter-of-factly explained why the experiment had failed.
entries.zh: 她就事论事地解释了实验失败的原因。

entries.en: We may as well wait inside the station.
entries.zh: 我们不妨在车站里面等。

entries.en: You mayn't enter the room without permission.
entries.zh: 未经允许，你不能进入这个房间。

entries.en: She applied for a means-tested housing benefit.
entries.zh: 她申请了一项须经经济情况审查的住房补助。

entries.en: I meant the smaller box, not the large one.
entries.zh: 我指的是较小的箱子，不是大的那个。

entries.en: The finished product must measure up to our standards.
entries.zh: 成品必须达到我们的标准。

entries.en: We happened to meet up outside the library.
entries.zh: 我们碰巧在图书馆外相遇。

entries.en: Her worries began to melt away after the phone call.
entries.zh: 打完电话后，她的忧虑开始消散。

entries.en: Do not mess with the controls while I am driving.
entries.zh: 我开车时，不要乱摆弄控制装置。

entries.en: We might as well walk while the weather is fine.
entries.zh: 趁天气好，我们不妨走过去。

entries.en: The coat is expensive; mind you, it is very well made.
entries.zh: 这件外套很贵，不过它的做工确实很好。

entries.en: Banks must not mis-sell insurance to unsuitable customers.
entries.zh: 银行不得向不适合的客户误导性销售保险。

entries.en: Even skilled players sometimes miskick under pressure.
entries.zh: 即使技术熟练的球员在压力下有时也会踢失。

entries.en: The inaccurate map misled us into taking the wrong path.
entries.zh: 不准确的地图误导我们走上了错误的小路。

entries.en: Do not miss out the final page of the form.
entries.zh: 不要漏掉表格的最后一页。

entries.en: I mistook her older brother for the delivery driver.
entries.zh: 我把她哥哥误认成了送货司机。

entries.en: The prompt apology mollified the angry customer.
entries.zh: 及时的道歉安抚了那位愤怒的顾客。

entries.en: His rude remark mortified the young host.
entries.zh: 他粗鲁的评论让年轻的主人感到羞愧难当。

entries.en: Two soldiers will mount guard beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 两名士兵将在入口旁站岗。

entries.en: There is little room to move about in here.
entries.zh: 这里几乎没有可以走动的空间。

entries.en: Please move along so others can enter.
entries.zh: 请继续往前走，让其他人也能进来。

entries.en: They plan to move away after their daughter graduates.
entries.zh: 他们打算在女儿毕业后搬走。

entries.en: Use this arrow to move down the list.
entries.zh: 用这个箭头在列表中向下移动。

entries.en: The bus will move off in a moment.
entries.zh: 公交车马上就要开走了。

entries.en: Everyone should muck in to prepare the hall.
entries.zh: 大家都应该一起动手布置礼堂。

entries.en: We need to muck out the stable today.
entries.zh: 我们今天需要清理马厩里的粪污。

entries.meaningZh: 使沾上泥，muddy 的过去式
entries.en: The children muddied their trousers beside the stream.
entries.zh: 孩子们在小溪边把裤子弄上了泥。

entries.en: We cannot muddle along without a proper budget.
entries.zh: 没有合适的预算，我们不能一直这样勉强应付。

entries.en: With some help, we should muddle through the first week.
entries.zh: 有一些帮助，我们应该能勉强熬过第一周。

entries.en: Do not muddle up the numbered pages.
entries.zh: 不要把标了页码的纸张弄乱。

entries.en: The operating system supports multi-tasking on older computers.
entries.zh: 这个操作系统支持在较旧的计算机上进行多任务处理。

entries.en: Larger firms may try to muscle in on the market.
entries.zh: 较大的公司可能会试图强行挤入这个市场。

entries.en: You mustn't leave the gate open at night.
entries.zh: 你晚上不得让大门敞着。

entries.en: We will nail up a warning sign tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我们明天会钉上一块警告牌。

entries.en: The witness refused to name names in public.
entries.zh: 证人拒绝公开指名道姓。

entries.en: He tends to name-drop when meeting new colleagues.
entries.zh: 他见到新同事时，往往会提及自己认识的名人来抬高身价。

entries.en: I brought my own umbrella, natch.
entries.zh: 我当然带了自己的伞。

entries.en: Needless to say, we were delighted by her success.
entries.zh: 不用说，我们都为她的成功感到高兴。

entries.en: You needn't bring any food to the party.
entries.zh: 你不必带食物来参加聚会。

entries.en: Never mind the rain; we can stay indoors.
entries.zh: 别担心下雨，我们可以待在室内。

entries.en: We had next to no money left.
entries.zh: 我们几乎没剩什么钱了。

entries.en: The hospital staff worked night and day.
entries.zh: 医院的工作人员夜以继日地工作。

entries.en: Nine times out of ten, a restart solves the problem.
entries.zh: 十有八九，重启就能解决这个问题。

entries.en: The project needs no less than six experienced workers.
entries.zh: 这个项目需要不少于六名熟练工人。

entries.en: The umpire called a no-ball during the final over.
entries.zh: 裁判在最后一轮投球中判了一次犯规投球。

entries.en: She tends to nose about in other people's business.
entries.zh: 她总爱打听别人的私事。

entries.en: We value this route, not least for its accessibility.
entries.zh: 我们看重这条路线，尤其是因为它便于通行。

entries.en: The team hopes to notch up another victory.
entries.zh: 这支队伍希望再赢得一场胜利。

entries.en: Please note down the number before you forget it.
entries.zh: 趁还没忘记，请把号码记下来。

entries.en: There was nothing but dust inside the box.
entries.zh: 盒子里只有灰尘。

entries.en: Her approach is nothing if not thorough.
entries.zh: 她的方法极其周全。

entries.en: The rescue was nothing less than a miracle.
entries.zh: 这次救援完全是一个奇迹。

entries.en: It was nothing more than a harmless joke.
entries.zh: 那不过是一个无伤大雅的玩笑。

entries.en: The presenter thanked the producer off-air after the interview.
entries.zh: 采访结束后，主持人在节目播送之外感谢了制片人。

entries.en: The company reconsidered offshoring after several quality problems.
entries.zh: 几次质量问题之后，公司重新考虑了离岸外包的安排。

entries.en: The meeting seemed to go on and on.
entries.zh: 会议似乎没完没了地持续着。

entries.en: The painting is on loan to the city museum.
entries.zh: 这幅画正借给市博物馆展出。

entries.en: She sent her portfolio to several publishers on spec.
entries.zh: 她把作品集寄给了几家出版商，想碰碰运气。

entries.en: The new processing plant will come on stream in May.
entries.zh: 新加工厂将于五月投产。

entries.en: They arranged the meeting on the quiet.
entries.zh: 他们私下安排了这次会面。

entries.term: on the side of the angels
entries.en: In this dispute, she was on the side of the angels.
entries.zh: 在这场争议中，她站在了道义正确的一方。
